rows.Bloom: Apricot or apricot blend. None to mild fragrance. 45 petals. Medium, borne mostly solitary, cluster-flowered, in small clusters, classic hybrid tea bloom form. Prolific, blooms in flushes throughout the season.

Upright. Large, glossy, medium green foliage.

Height: up to 3' (up to 90cm).
